extension.description: Aura is highly customisable skin with multiple widgets and a horizontal home menu. Aura combines the minimalism and rounded edges of Arctic Zephyr with the sleek customisability of Horizon. Whilst the best Aura experience is had with a remote, Aura has been designed to accomodate mouse and touch users where possible.

extension.summary: Install builds and switch layouts for StarWave
extension.description: Installs and updates StarWave builds, and switches between layouts. Update keeps your Kodi settings, sources, favourites and every add-on login; Fresh Install resets to the build defaults. Switching layout changes only the skin and its menu - credentials and preferences are never touched, because no skin stores them. Kodi is closed at the end; reopen it to finish.

customizable Fan-Out target add-on filtering; Fresh Wipe preserves File Manager sources and re-seeds wizard; IPTV startup modal popup storm suppression; clean Trakt state on fresh install. 5.4.3 - Streamlined menu: removed obsolete items (Repair Streaming, Back up settings, Reset audio/display); fixed live version reporting in device readout. 5.4.2 - Added GitHub OAuth Device Flow (TV QR Code & 8-character device login) to easily unlock protected builds without typing tokens. 5.4.1 - Added Fresh Wipe (Factory Reset) to clean wipe Kodi; restored the backup stream provider after its old domain went dead; the version screen now shows date, time and timezone, and which accounts this device is signed in to. 5.2.0 - Sports Hub lists live games from ESPN and resolves a stream when you click one. 5.1.0 - The live-stream fix is now re-applied at every start rather than only when it is run by hand. 5.0.0 - StarWave v5: Integrated Canonical Sports Engine (1 Game = 1 Card) into Arctic Fuse 3 Wall Landscape Sports Hub, Live TV EPG auto-sync, and native Top Drawer shortcuts. 4.16.1 - Fully automated PVR IPTV Simple & IPTV Merge self-configuration on startup across Android and SteamOS. 4.16.0 - Allow re-applying active layout configurations and refresh updated skinvariables nodes from the repository. 4.15.1 - Fix submenu group resolution: key Sports and TV submenu files to sanitized plugin IDs (plugin-video-thecrew, slyguy-pluto-tv-provider). 4.15.0 - Phase 2: SlyGuy FAST channels (Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, The Roku Channel) and dedicated TV home section. 4.14.0 - Phase 1 home menu rebuild: 5+5 Settings grid with version rules and static skin tiles, dedicated Sports section with The Crew routes, Quit tile in Settings. 4.13.1 - Add-ons with no recorded origin are now resolved by asking every installed repository, and the wizard reports the skin and wizard versions alongside the build version. 4.13.0 - The wizard now updates essential video and scraper add-ons (Umbrella, The Crew, Seren, Gears, CocoScrapers, ResolveURL) directly from their origin repositories when Kodi stops offering updates. extension.summary: Add-ons for the StarWave Kodi build
extension.description: Hosts the add-ons the StarWave build depends on that are not available from any other repository — the skin, its image and screensaver resource packs, the Star Hubs setup screen, and the accounts module. The build's original maintainer disappeared and their server went offline; this repository exists so those add-ons remain installable.
